design: Safe, deterministic, OFFLINE batch-control layer. NEVER executes prompt text (no exec/eval), never runs tests/daemon/Codex, never mutates git. Validates a batch manifest (slug batch_id, max_prompts cap 10, batch-relative prompt paths with no absolute/traversal, existing prompt files, safe tags + repo-relative artifact paths); determines next runnable prompt in deterministic order; records operator receipts; verifies post-prompt EVIDENCE (expected tag via injectable read-only tag_checker, expected report+summary files, status field match); scores each prompt /100 (objective 40 + constraint 30 + evidence 20 + risk 10) with continue/stop; advances only on PASS; blocks on invalid manifest, previous failure (stop_on_failure), or dirty source (injectable source_status_provider); emits a clear next-Claude-Code instruction referencing the prompt file.
final_decision: Implemented the safe project prompt-batch execution controller: model + validation, controller (analyze/next/record-receipt/evaluate/advance), CLI, and example batch. It validates batches, selects the next runnable prompt, verifies post-prompt evidence (tag/report/summary/status via injectable read-only providers), scores each prompt /100, advances only on PASS, and blocks on failure/dirty-source/unsafe manifest — without EVER executing prompt text (no exec/eval) or running the daemon/Codex/git. 19 controller tests + 111 total regression OK; additive only; protected modules untouched.
